section.8: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

8.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

hadiths.text: The aforesaid tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari through a different chain of narrators. This version adds:Be lenient to yourselves, O people
